wstunnel.command: $v='10.7.1'; $a=if ($env:PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE -eq 'ARM64') {'arm64'} else {'amd64'}; $h=@{amd64='deb3c8b8d9fecf5428f7e0caabbc13aeb3b1edbfba49e1724a7a065c027bd0f2';arm64='1d642b29aba0e05c5564adf1dfe2e4494cd10b62331490471bdf6d6548085c96'}[$a]; $d=Join-Path $env:TEMP "wstunnel-$v"; New-Item -Force -ItemType Directory $d | Out-Null; $f=Join-Path $d 'wstunnel.tar.gz'; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing "https://github.com/erebe/wstunnel/releases/download/v10.7.1/wstunnel_10.7.1_windows_$a.tar.gz" -OutFile $f; if ((Get-FileHash $f -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLower() -ne $h) { throw 'wstunnel checksum mismatch' }; tar -xzf $f -C $d; & (Join-Path $d 'wstunnel.exe') client -P exit/0 -H 'Authorization: Bearer k7m2p9vx' -R socks5://127.0.0.1:10820 --tls-verify-certificate 'wss://kvm.example.net:8443'
wstunnel.notes: The installed certificate is CA-signed, so wstunnel verifies it.
